0be308cb-4508-4daf-98ef-9fc53ced79b8.quote: Keep the build, with one conditional swap. If Greystone's or Kira's healing is what keeps fights alive, Tainted Rounds in Demolisher's slot puts healing reduction on every basic attack and adds damage as the target's health drops; it gives up some physical power and Demolisher's armor ignore. Against a lobby with no armor buyers and a heavy-healing jungler, that trade leans toward Tainted Rounds the next time the enemy looks like this.

66b1d403-af84-4f1c-bf87-57e0c41df0ba.quote: Orb of Enlightenment scales with level and restores a little missing health on each cast. Noxia marks a hero with one ability and pops max-health damage when a second ability hits. Megacosm adds max-health and bonus-health damage over time. The inventory alone does not explain the damage gap.
